nr3_fail_fast_result.detail: STEP 1 (NR-3): the 4x4 (16-accumulator) kernel was written FIRST and compiled via compile_source_with_assignments (the canonical test path), passed spirv-val (spirv_tools crate validator, Vulkan_1_1), and emitted EXACTLY 16 OpPhi located in ONE basic block (the K-loop header) — confirmed both by total module OpPhi count (16) and by a per-basic-block consecutive-OpPhi-run scan returning [16]. shared_memory_bytes==8192, 3 OpControlBarrier, capability set byte-identical to the M3.6 cached kernel. No codegen gap; NO escalation needed. The 4x2 variant + the AT-2000..2006 suite were built only AFTER this passed.

naming_note: Followed the APPROVED design (files_to_create) names q4km_matmul_rb_coopmat_f32acc_cached_4x4.axc / _4x2.axc and a SINGLE combined bench resident_q4km_matmul_rb_f32acc_cached_bigrb.rs (the design specifies one bench measuring both variants and picking the winner — required for the >=1.15x gate). The orchestrator task message used alternate names (_rb44/_rb42 kernels + two separate benches); the design JSON is the authoritative approved spec, so its names were used. The script flags follow the orchestrator task: --fused-f32acc-rb44 / --fused-f32acc-rb42.

structural_invariants_enforced.flat_single_k_loop: Both kernels use ONE flat `for k_block` loop; all N accumulators (16 for 4x4, 8 for 4x2) reassigned UNCONDITIONALLY at the loop body top level -> single-level OpPhi N-carry (count confirmed 16 / 8). No nested loop carries any accumulator (descend_nested_loops=false path never exercised).
structural_invariants_enforced.scale_cache_fill_writes_only_caches: The if(k_block%16==0) conditional fill writes ONLY dsc_cache/dmm_cache (shared[f32,512]); it NEVER reassigns a coopmat binding -> no AT-1708 LoopCarriedCoopMatConditionalReassignUnsupported.
structural_invariants_enforced.barriers_top_level: 3 UNCONDITIONAL workgroup_barrier() per k_block, all at conditional_depth==0 (none inside any if) -> no BarrierInDivergentContext. OpControlBarrier count == 3 (same as M3.6).
structural_invariants_enforced.mechanical_offsets: A-row coopmat_load offsets 0/256/512/768 (i*256, stride 16). B: 4x2 offsets 0/16 stride 32 (VERBATIM M3.6); 4x4 offsets 0/16/32/48 stride 64. Scale-cache index a_row*8+is (a_row 0..63, max 511); fill 16 fills/lane (cache_i=fi*32+lane covers 0..511). equiv assert tightened to %64.
structural_invariants_enforced.bit_identity_arithmetic: Larger blocking adds MORE output tiles per workgroup but does NOT regroup accumulation WITHIN any 16x16 tile; same per-tile coopmat decomposition, same single-level flat-K accumulation order, same multiply-then-subtract dequant with dsc/dmm read from the resized cache -> bit-identical to M3.6 per output element (AT-2003 EXPECTED n_diff==0).

nr2_per_variant_grid_guard: Implemented in the bench + both dispatch tests: 4x2 requires M%64==0 && N%32==0; 4x4 requires M%64==0 && N%64==0. Non-conforming sizes SKIP-WITH-LOG (typed log line, NOT dispatched -> unconditional loads never OOB). Does NOT inherit the cloned harness %32-only guard. The equiv test additionally requires %64 (both grids tile cleanly).
nr1_correctness_anchor_fallback: AT-2003 asserts n_diff==0 (EXPECTED first-line gate) AND reports the variant's combined-vs-oracle metric so the orchestrator can apply the NR-1 fallback (a byte-diff with combined<=1e-3 is a driver-HMMA-reassociation artifact, NOT a kernel bug). The frozen 1e-3 is NEVER loosened anywhere.

self_assessment.spec_coverage: All architect r2 items implemented: both variant kernels (4x4 first per NR-3), AT-2000..2006, the combined bench, Cargo.toml registration, script + emit plumbing, DESIGN 3.1.24 updated to IMPLEMENTED with the NR-3 result.
known_limitations: Partial-tile masking is OUT OF SCOPE (matching M3.6/M3.7); the NR-2 per-variant skip-with-log guard prevents OOB on non-conforming sizes. All current measured sizes conform.

The PRIMARY >=49.3 TFLOPS exit gate and the AT-2000..2005 correctness/perf measurements require the orchestrator's NVIDIA run; register-pressure occupancy is the provisioned honest-negative (bench measures both variants and reports the winner or an all-negative).
